mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% for two consecutive months predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to market anticipation of rate hikes.
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite inflation above 2% threshold, or inflation decelerates before the 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% signals wage pressure, which precedes a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as firms anticipate higher profits.
failure_condition: Over 12-month period, 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline when PAYEMS rises >0.5%, or correlation with SPX is <0.2.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 2% suggests weakening demand, leading to a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate softer earnings.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < prev_month and GDPC1 < GDPC1 two months ago by >2%
failure_condition: Over 100 observations, 5-day forward returns are non-negative despite the defined demand decline, or GDPC1 recovers before the 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in INDPRO manufacturing index below 95 triggers a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates supply-side easing and potential price gains.
failure_condition: More than 50% of INDPRO <95 events yield non-positive 20-day returns, or INDPRO recovers before the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4.25% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 exhibits a negative 20-day forward return as markets price in higher borrowing costs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.25 and FEDFUNDS next two months > 4.25
failure_condition: Over 200 such events, 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS falls before the window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE unemployment below 4.5% triggers a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market tightening is seen as supportive of corporate profits.
failure_condition: More than 30 such episodes yield non-positive 60-day returns, or UNRATE rebounds before the 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in RSAFS retail sales exceeding 2% predict a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as investor sentiment deteriorates due to weak demand.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < prev_month and RSAFS < prev_prev_month by >2%
failure_condition: Over 100 such events, 5-day returns are not negative, or RSAFS recovers before the window.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST industrial production falls by more than 3% in a month, the S&P 500 shows a positive 20-day forward return as market anticipates supply-side weakness and potential price support.
failure_condition: More than 40 such events result in non-positive 20-day returns, or HOUST recovers before the window.
